Core Areas Where Your PC Loses Speed

Understanding why your device slows down helps you target the fixes effectively. The most common performance killers include:

Startup Bloat

Too many apps launching automatically consume precious RAM and CPU cycles upon boot.

Registry Clutter

Corrupt or obsolete registry entries cause system instability and application errors.

Junk Data Accumulation

Leftover temporary cache files silently consume gigabytes of valuable storage space.

Background Processes

Hidden programs draining internet bandwidth and resources without your knowledge.
